content:
[L] high | entire window below header | defect: ~90% of the viewport is a completely empty black dead zone with no content, placeholder, or empty-state message.
[H] high | top-left header | defect: "LIVE" title is in a raw monospace/terminal font that clashes with the sans-serif metadata text beside it, reading as debug output rather than a product header.
[C] high | whole screen | defect: the screen is a single orphaned toolbar floating at the top with no panels, tables, tickets, or any helpdesk functionality visible at all.
[C] high | header status text | defect: the string "never shows relative time — forensic value" is developer-facing commentary leaked into the user-facing UI.
[L] med | far right of header | defect: the green "LIVE" pill sits in isolation with no border or container alignment tying it to the rest of the header, appearing tacked on at the window edge.
[H] med | header metadata | defect: the raw timestamp "2026-10-27 04:31:12" is presented at near-equal weight to the page title, making metadata compete with primary content.
[S] med | header baseline | defect: the monospace "LIVE", the metadata sentence, and the pill are vertically misaligned, with the small text sitting on a different baseline than the large title.
[S] low | left edge | defect: "LIVE" title is nearly flush against the window's left edge with an inconsistent inset compared to the generous spacing elsewhere in the bar.
[H] low | header | defect: two competing "LIVE" labels (large title and green pill) duplicate the same word with different styling, creating confusion about which is the status indicator.

VERDICT: unprofessional — an empty black void with a leaked debug note and mismatched fonts, nowhere near product quality.

Defect-free regions: none beyond the header strip itself; the entire lower region is vacant.
